verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a public API reference. It covers API-key and OAuth 2.0 authentication that works on every endpoint, a create-agent endpoint, sessions with streaming, and chat completions, plus official Python and JavaScript SDKs, so a user can drive agents programmatically. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and the SDK repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
